headline: Malden Emergency Management Committee reviews preparedness, training, grants, and department reports.
summary: The committee will cover emergency management coordinator updates, recent emergency activations, upcoming events, training and CERT volunteer programs. It will also review grant and project updates, communications, department reports, and regional and seasonal preparedness.
items: Emergency Management Coordinator Report: recent activities, initiatives, and key updates
Emergency Activations Review: recent incidents, after-action items, and lessons learned
Upcoming Events & Operational Planning: special events, planned activations, and coordination needs
Preparedness & Training: drills, exercises, training opportunities, and EOC readiness
CERT & Volunteer Programs: recruitment, training, and community outreach
Grant & Project Updates: EMPG, hazard mitigation, resilience initiatives, and funding opportunities
Communications & Public Information: emergency notifications, public outreach, and preparedness messaging
Department Reports: Fire, Police, Public Health, DPW, Public Facilities, Schools, Communications, Other Departments
Regional, State & Seasonal Updates: MEMA, mutual aid, weather outlook, and seasonal preparedness
New Business: emerging issues, resource needs, and future planning
location: Room 108, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St, Malden, MA
